TEXT: [FI] And on the day of the date--

[FI] I sighed when I felt the unprecedented attention 
that we attracted.
[FI] Of course, the reason is standing right next to me--

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Is something the matter, Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, it's nothing.

[FI] People walking down the streets are all turning to 
catch a glimpse of Ayase. Well, with such a cute 
girl around, it's natural we'd attract attention.

[FI] Being able to call her my girlfriend makes me feel 
so proud. Still...

[FI] I hadn't expected to come to Akihabara with 
Ayase ever again.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] So, where should we start off?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You seem pretty motivated today.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] That's because I've put a lot of effort into 
preparing for today.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] If it's about Meruru, I've read up on it. The anime's 
third season starts airing soon. Kanako said so as 
well.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] And then there was Mas...chera? Or something? 
There are still many enthusiastic fans who haven't 
given up on a second season yet.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Okay, I get it. That's enough.

[FI] Something about her reciting all of her otaku 
knowledge in that monotone voice frightens me.
[FI] But it seems like she really did study up on it.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Hm... Okay then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, let's just start with something that's closeby.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Yes. I'll leave it to you then, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I noticed this the last time we were here, but there 
are a lot of people in different costumes around 
here.

[FI] That's what Ayase thought as we stepped onto 
Akiba's central street for the first time in a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, that's right.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] And there seems to be more maids around than 
last time, for some reason.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, that's just to attract potential customers.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Eh? But if it's just for a cafe, wouldn't this be too 
many people?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] These days, there are maids in all sorts of 
businesses.

[FI] I've heard they employ maids in more than just 
cafes lately. From bars to ear picking, there are all 
kinds of services now.

[FI] After giving her an explanation, Ayase's expression 
stiffened a bit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] O-Onii-san, you seem to know a lot about this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Nah, not really.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=28]You do![/font_size] Y-You haven't gone to some shop 
to have your ears picked, have you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Never. Besides, if I wanted someone to pick my 
ears, I'd rather have it done by you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] G-[font_size=22]Geez[/font_size][font_size=21],[/font_size] [font_size=21]Onii-san[/font_size][font_size=20].[/font_size] [font_size=20]You[/font_size] [font_size=19]keep[/font_size] [font_size=19]asking[/font_size] [font_size=18]these[/font_size] [font_size=15]embarrassing[/font_size] 
[font_size=13]things...[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No go?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Well, that's...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Geez, no matter what you say, that won't happen.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Should've known, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] That's right. I'm a serious girl.

[FI] Serious, huh. True, Ayase's way of thinking is best 
described as straightforward and level-headed.
[FI] And she's quite a stickler for the rules.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] But more importantly, where did all that knowledge 
come from? You didn't seem to know this much 
the last time we came.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I heard a lot from some people who come to 
Akiba quite often.

[FI] As I said that, I took out a piece of paper that 
Ayase immediately showed great interest in.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] That's an incredibly detailed map. I don't think we'll 
be able to visit all the places in just one day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah, once I said I wanted to bring my girlfriend to 
Akiba, she went to great lengths to make me this 
map.

[FI] From places aimed at the general public to the 
more specialised stores, everything was thoroughly 
described.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I gotta hand it to Saori.

[FI] I expressed my thanks to the creator of the map 
and turned to face Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] So first up... Let's go check out some doujinshi, shall 
we?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Doujinshi... You mean that stuff they sold at 
Comiket?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah. The major circles tend to sell their goods 
through consignment.

[FI] I taught Ayase all I knew about Akihabara as we 
were walking to our first stop.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] No matter how many times I see it, this place is 
really intense.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah.

[FI] I've gotten used to it thanks to Kirino and the 
others, but like Ayase said, it really is an intense 
environment.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, isn't this a Meruru doujinshi?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Looks like it.

[FI] Seeing Ayase like this, I unintentionally breathed a 
sigh of relief.
[FI] Seems like her tolerance is pretty high today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If it continues like this, the day she comes to accept 
Kirino's hobbies might not be so far away.

[FI] Afterwards, we went to some other book and 
game shops. Then we decided for a change of 
pace and went into a different store.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...This is amazing. It looks almost like the real thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] E-Err, Ayase-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] What's the matter, Onii-san? Stop hiding in the 
corner and come here.

[FI] No, Ayase. I'm sorry but even I wouldn't dare 
approach you right now.
[FI] Or rather...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Strange. [font_size=28]I think I'm taking a fancy to this 
store...[/font_size]

[FI] It could be my imagination, but I think I felt 
something ominous in Ayase's eyes as she was 
caressing the edged tool.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] H-Hey, Ayase. Isn't it about time we left?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Is that so? Still, just a bit longer...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] No, sorry, but I'm getting pretty hungry! Let's go 
eat something!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah...

[FI] I grabbed the reluctant Ayase and rushed out of 
the store.

[FI] I'm definitely never bringing Ayase to a store like 
this again.
[FI] No, seriously.
